sentences.text: Shri Shahid Shaikh, learned counsel for the appellant.
Ms. Darshana Baghel, learned counsel for the responden Shri Unnit Jhanjhari, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Heard on I.A.No.7251/2018, an application filed under Section 5 and 14 of the Limitation Act for condoning the delay as well as excluding the period for which wrong proceedings were pursued by the appellant.
The case of the appellant is that on 27.8.2015 award was passed.
Pursuant to which some of the land of the appellant was acquired.
Being dissatisfied with this award he filed reference in terms of Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.
In the said reference order was passed against the appellant in the year 2017.

Being aggrieved by the said order he filed review petition before the same Court,
which was dismissed by the Court on 16.9.2017 by holding that review is not maintainable.

Against this order a revision petition was filed in the year 2017 itself before this Court i.e. C.R.No.13/2017,
which was decided by this Court on 21.3.2018 by holding that appellant has a proper remedy of appeal in terms of Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act.

In view of the above facts learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant was diligently pursuing his case, but it is only doe to advise given by his counsel he prosecuted his case before the wrong Forum.
as such 2 FA-2017-2018 the entire period for which the proceedings were pending before the concerned Courts in review as well as in revision petition deserves to be excluded.

Apart from this, he submits that there is a delay for the period after dismissal of revision petition till filing of the first appeal, which was filed only on 23.7.2018, which was for the reason that the dismissal of revision petition was not duly communicated by the counsel to him.
Considering the above facts the delay in filing present appeal is hereby condoned.
However, it is left open for the period of delay whether interest should be awarded or not, which shall be considered at the time of final hearing of this appeal.
As the appeal is relating to compensation arising out of acquisition of the land of appellant, list the same in the month of March, 2026 for final arguments.

(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE patil Sattar Patel vs Commissioner on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105778420/
